wikidot5e:spell:counterspell.effectSummary: Interrupt a creature you can see casting a spell within 60 feet. A spell of 3rd level or lower fails automatically. For a spell of 4th level or higher, make a spellcasting-ability check against DC 10 + the spell's level; on a success it fails. If you use a slot of 4th level or higher, the interrupted spell fails automatically when its level is no higher than the slot you used.

wikidot5e:spell:create-bonfire.effectSummary: Create a bonfire filling a 5-foot cube on visible ground in range. A creature in the space when cast, entering it for the first time on a turn, or ending its turn there makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d8 fire damage. The fire ignites flammable unattended objects in its area. Damage becomes 2d8 at character level 5, 3d8 at 11, and 4d8 at 17.

wikidot5e:spell:create-homunculus.effectSummary: During the casting you cut yourself with the required dagger and take 2d4 piercing damage that cannot be reduced, then transform the other components into a homunculus using the Monster Manual statistics. It is your faithful companion and dies if you die. When you finish a long rest while it is on the same plane, you may spend up to half your Hit Dice; roll each spent die and add your Constitution modifier to each, reduce your hit point maximum by the total without reducing you below 1 HP, and increase both the homunculus's maximum and current HP by that total. Those HP changes end at your next long rest; your maximum-HP reduction cannot be removed earlier except by the homunculus's death. You can have only one homunculus, and casting this spell while yours still lives fails.

wikidot5e:spell:create-magen.effectSummary: Transform the prepared life-sized doll into a magen of a type you choose during casting, dressed in whatever the doll wore. When it appears, your hit point maximum is reduced by its challenge rating, with a minimum reduction of 1; only wish can undo this reduction. A magen you create this way obeys your commands without question.

wikidot5e:spell:create-or-destroy-water.effectSummary: Choose creation or destruction. Create Water produces up to 10 gallons of clean water in an open container or rain in a 30-foot cube that extinguishes exposed flames. Destroy Water removes up to 10 gallons from an open container or destroys fog in a 30-foot cube. Each slot level above 1st adds 10 gallons or increases the cube by 5 feet per side.

wikidot5e:spell:create-undead.effectSummary: Cast only at night. Choose up to three Small or Medium humanoid corpses in range; each becomes a ghoul under your control. As a bonus action, mentally command any or all undead you animated with this spell that are within 120 feet, giving the same order to those commanded together. You can specify their next action and movement or a general standing order; without an order they only defend themselves, and an order persists until complete. Control lasts 24 hours. Recasting before control expires reasserts control over up to three of these undead for another 24 hours instead of animating new ones. A 7th-level slot handles four ghouls; an 8th-level slot handles five ghouls or two ghasts or wights; a 9th-level slot handles six ghouls, three ghasts or wights, or two mummies.

wikidot5e:spell:creation.effectSummary: Create a nonliving object of a form and material you have seen, no larger than a 5-foot cube. It can be vegetable matter or mineral material. Its duration is determined by its shortest-lived material: vegetable matter 1 day; stone or crystal 12 hours; precious metals 1 hour; gems 10 minutes; adamantine or mithral 1 minute. Material created by this spell causes another spell to fail if used as that spell's material component. Each slot level above 5th increases the maximum cube dimension by 5 feet.

wikidot5e:spell:crown-of-madness.effectSummary: One visible humanoid in range makes a Wisdom save or is charmed for the duration. Before moving on each of its turns, the charmed target must use its action to make a melee attack against another creature you mentally choose; if you choose no creature or none is within reach, it can act normally. On each of your later turns you must use your action to maintain control or the spell ends. The target repeats the Wisdom save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on a success.

wikidot5e:spell:crown-of-stars.effectSummary: Create seven orbiting star-like motes for 1 hour. As a bonus action, expend one mote to make a ranged spell attack against a creature or object within 120 feet; on a hit it deals 4d12 radiant damage, and the mote is expended whether the attack hits or misses. The spell ends when the last mote is spent. Four or more remaining motes shed bright light for 30 feet and dim light for another 30 feet; one to three shed dim light for 30 feet. Each slot level above 7th creates two additional motes.

wikidot5e:spell:crusaders-mantle.effectSummary: A 30-foot-radius aura moves with you. Until the spell ends, every nonhostile creature in the aura, including you, deals an extra 1d4 radiant damage whenever it hits with a weapon attack.
